title: USB-C Hub HDMI Not Working? 8 Checks Before You Return It (India)
excerpt: USB-C hub HDMI showing no signal? Most of the time the laptop port has no DisplayPort Alt Mode. Eight checks in order, plus why 4K often runs at 30Hz.
seoTitle: USB-C Hub HDMI Not Working? 8 Fixes Before You Return It
seoDesc: USB-C hub HDMI no signal? Check DP Alt Mode on the laptop port, hub power, cable and Windows display settings, and why HDMI 1.4 hubs limit 4K to 30Hz.
